results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if connection inactive or scopes changed)] [Prerequisite]: Initiate/complete authorization using CAL_CONNECT_TO_CALENDAR (continue only once the connection is active).

[Optional (if consent cannot be completed or scope errors persist)] [Fallback]: Generate a consent URL using CAL_GET_GOOGLE_CALENDAR_OAUTH_AUTHENTICATION_URL (complete consent) then retry CAL_CONNECT_TO_CALENDAR.
[Required] [Step]: Enumerate accessible calendars using GOOGLECALENDAR_LIST_CALENDARS (store calendars[].id, primary, accessRole; paginate using the returned page-token field until absent).
[Optional (if constructing relative/local-day windows)] [Prerequisite]: Get an offset-aware reference timestamp using GOOGLECALENDAR_GET_CURRENT_DATE_TIME (derive valid time_min/time_max bounds).

[Required] [Step]: Verify read access using GOOGLECALENDAR_EVENTS_LIST_ALL_CALENDARS (query a bounded window; tune response_detail for payload size; if unexpectedly empty, widen/shift bounds before concluding no events).

[Optional (if results are ambiguous or you need strict per-calendar reads)] [Next Step]: Query a single calendar using GOOGLECALENDAR_EVENTS_LIST (use calendar_id from GOOGLECALENDAR_LIST_CALENDARS to isolate visibility/scope issues).

[Optional (if timezone/metadata is needed to interpret timestamps)] [Next Step]: Fetch timezone context using GOOGLECALENDAR_GET_CALENDAR and/or GOOGLECALENDAR_SETTINGS_LIST (normalize time_min/time_max and display consistently).
known_pitfalls: [GOOGLECALENDAR_LIST_CALENDARS] HTTP 403 insufficientPermissions / ACCESS_TOKEN_SCOPE_INSUFFICIENT indicates missing OAuth scopes; re-run consent before retrying reads.
[GOOGLECALENDAR_LIST_CALENDARS] Pagination cursor field names vary (nextPageToken vs next_page_token); next_sync_token may appear but is not a page cursor.
[GOOGLECALENDAR_EVENTS_LIST_ALL_CALENDARS] Invalid/inverted time_min/time_max can yield an empty result without an explicit error; adjust bounds before treating as no data.
[GOOGLECALENDAR_EVENTS_LIST_ALL_CALENDARS] response_detail='minimal' may populate only a compact/summary view while omitting a full events array; request fuller detail only when required.
[GOOGLECALENDAR_EVENTS_LIST_ALL_CALENDARS] Event start/end can be all-day (date) or timed (dateTime); parsers must handle both shapes.

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Normalize event start time shape (dateTime vs date) from a JSON response.
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
import json,sys
p=json.load(sys.stdin)
ev=p.get('items') or p.get('events') or []
ss=[((e.get('start') or {}).get('dateTime') or (e.get('start') or {}).get('date')) for e in ev]
ss=[s for s in ss if s]
print(len(ev), ss[:5])
```

CAL_CONNECT_TO_CALENDAR.description: Initiates or checks the external connection status for a specified calendar, possibly returning a redirect URL for user authorization to complete integration, without altering calendar data.

calendar.description: The calendar type to connect to. Valid values: apple, google, office365

GOOGLECALENDAR_LIST_CALENDARS.description: Retrieves calendars from the user's Google Calendar list, with options for pagination and filtering. Loop through all pages using nextPageToken until absent to avoid missing calendars. Use the primary flag and accessRole field from the response to identify calendars — display names are not valid calendar_id values. Read access (listing) does not imply write OAuth scopes.

page_token.description: Token for the page of results to return, from a previous response.

sync_token.description: Sync token from a previous list request to get only changed entries; showDeleted, showHidden, and pageToken are ignored if provided. Also ignores minAccessRole. An HTTP 410 Gone response means the token has expired; perform a full resync by omitting sync_token.

max_results.description: Maximum number of calendars to return per page. Max 250.

show_hidden.description: Include calendars not typically shown in the UI.

show_deleted.description: Include deleted calendars in the result.

min_access_role.description: Minimum access role for calendars returned. Valid values are 'freeBusyReader', 'owner', 'reader', 'writer'. freeBusyReader calendars expose only free/busy slots — no event details and writes fail with 403. Omit this filter to include read-only calendars.

GOOGLECALENDAR_GET_CALENDAR.description: Retrieves a specific Google Calendar, identified by `calendar_id`, to which the authenticated user has access. Response includes `timeZone` (IANA format, e.g., 'America/Los_Angeles') — use it directly when constructing `timeMin`/`timeMax` in other tools to avoid DST errors. An empty `defaultReminders` list is valid (no defaults configured). Insufficient `accessRole` may omit fields like `defaultReminders` and `colorId`.

calendar_id.description: Identifier of the Google Calendar to retrieve. Must be 'primary' (the default) for the user's main calendar, or an email-like identifier (e.g., 'user@example.com' or 'en.usa#holiday@group.v.calendar.google.com'). IMPORTANT: Calendar display names/titles (e.g., 'Work', 'Vacation') are NOT valid identifiers and will result in errors. To find a calendar's ID, use the LIST_CALENDARS action which returns the 'id' field for each calendar.
